summary: Iteration 5 – frontend verification of add-patient bug-fix bundle. All 5 primary acceptance flows PASS. (1) Unauth navigation to /add-patient is redirected to /login by RootNav in _layout.tsx. (2) Editor session renders the form normally: viewer-notice absent, all 5 upload buttons (pre_op-add-image, pre_op-add-doc, post_op-add-image, post_op-add-doc, add-video-btn) opacity=1 & no aria-disabled, mic + save present. (3) Viewer session shows yellow testID=viewer-notice with correct copy and all 5 upload buttons rendered opacity=0.5 with aria-disabled=true. (4) Backend spot-check unchanged: /api/patients returns 401 unauth and 200 for admin. (5) Token-guard and upload-failure banner code paths verified by source review at add-patient.tsx L94-96/L122-123/L146-147 (`if (!token) setUploadError('Signing you in — please try again in a moment.')`) and L110-117/L134-141/L162-169 (catch → setUploadError + Haptics.notificationAsync Error). authLoading gate confirmed at L303. Minor UX observation: because the upload Pressables use React Native `disabled={isViewer || uploading}`, the viewer-role early-return inside pickImages/pickDocs/pickVideo is not actually reachable via a tap — React Native swallows onPress on disabled Pressables. The viewer already sees the persistent viewer-notice banner so behavior is fine; but if the spec intent is that tapping the disabled button ALSO shows a transient 'Viewers cannot upload files' banner, the `disabled` prop needs to be removed or replaced with a manual guard.

integration_issues.flow: Viewer tap on disabled upload button
integration_issues.issue: Viewer taps on pre_op-add-image/etc. do not fire onPress because React Native Pressables have disabled={isViewer||uploading} (add-patient.tsx L442, L724, L736). The `if (isViewer) setUploadError(...)` early-return branch inside pickImages/pickDocs/pickVideo is unreachable in this path. The persistent yellow viewer-notice banner still communicates the state, so functionally acceptable, but the acceptance criterion 'their onPress handlers early-return with a friendly error banner' is only satisfied structurally, not observably.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If tapping a disabled upload button should also flash the transient upload-error-banner for viewers, drop the `disabled` prop on those Pressables and rely solely on the in-handler guard + visual opacity styling. Currently users just see the persistent yellow viewer-notice, which is arguably clearer.
No other action items — unauth redirect, editor happy-path, viewer visual gating, authLoading spinner, token guard, and upload-error handling with haptics are all correctly implemented.
critical_code_review_comments: add-patient.tsx L442, L724, L736 — Pressable `disabled` prop makes the in-handler viewer/`!token` guards unreachable via tap. Consider: `onPress={isViewer ? () => setUploadError('Viewers cannot upload…') : pickImages}` and drop `disabled={isViewer}` while keeping opacity for visual affordance.
add-patient.tsx L303 — early return renders a bare centered ActivityIndicator without a testID. Adding testID='auth-loading' would make the loading gate deterministically testable.
add-patient.tsx is 830 lines — approaching the 700-line advisory limit. Consider extracting MediaSection, FileGrid, SubHeading, Section, Field to /src/components/patient-form/ for maintainability.
auth/index.tsx L77-78 — silent catch in exchange(). Consider surfacing a user-visible error toast on session exchange failure so users understand why they landed back on /login.
